changelog.why: The stamp gated nothing and no writer had filled it for a month.

changelog.change: pipeline_fingerprint is optional and nothing sets it.
changelog.why: The stamp stopped being a gate, so the eval row this copies stopped filling it.

changelog.change: item_id accepts a second shape: sixteen Crockford base32 symbols.
changelog.why: Ten decimal digits is 33 bits of an address, which collides on a busy day.

changelog.change: Initial shape: the measurement's identity, the premise, and the summary.
changelog.why: The faithfulness bands are a reader-facing promise with no measured human error.

description: One scored item's premise and summary, addressed by the measurement it belongs to.

premise.description: The article after extraction, sanitizing and the truncation cap - the text the scorer read, byte for byte. Untrusted (Guardrail #11): it prints as inert terminal text and never becomes a prompt, a path or a URL.
premise.title: Premise

source_digest.description: sha256 of `premise`, the same value the eval row carries. Recomputed on read, so an edited premise fails to load rather than reaching a labeller.
source_digest.title: Source Digest

summary.description: The summary the scorer scored against `premise`. The published item also carries key points; they are left out because the scorer never read them, and showing a labeller words the number does not cover would put the two of them back on different questions.
summary.title: Summary
